gd.where: Self-employed 20%, design studios 9%, advertising and PR 8%
gd.entry: Bachelor's degree. Common first job out of a BFA.
gd.what: Creates logos, layouts, packaging and web graphics that communicate an idea.
duties: Create designs, concepts and sample layouts based on layout principles and design concepts
Decide the size and arrangement of images and copy, and choose typefaces and type sizes
Develop graphics and layouts for product illustrations, company logos and websites
Meet with clients to discuss and decide on layout design
Research the target audience for each project
Use software to create new images, charts, graphs and illustrations
Prepare digital files for printing
Review final layouts and suggest improvements

ad.where: Self-employed 62%, advertising and PR 11%, publishing and media 4%
ad.entry: Bachelor's plus 5 or more years, usually starting as a graphic designer.
ad.what: Leads the visual style of campaigns and directs designers, photographers and video teams.
duties: Work with creative directors to develop design solutions
Meet with clients to set objectives, budget, background and presentation approach
Present final layouts to clients for approval
Manage your own accounts and projects within budget and schedule
Plan the layout or presentation approach and specify details such as type style and size
Review and approve art, copy and printed proofs made by the creative team
Attend photo shoots and print sessions to make sure the work comes out right
Create custom illustrations or other graphic elements

cw.where: Self-employed 65%, the rest mostly in advertising and media
cw.entry: Bachelor's degree. Figures cover all writers and authors.
cw.what: Writes ads, slogans and campaign copy, usually paired with an art director.
cw.payNote: Range covers all writers and authors.
duties: Write advertising for print, broadcast and online media that promotes sales
Develop advertising campaigns with an agency's creative and art directors
Invent product names and write slogans for packaging and promotion
Research a product's selling points to decide which to promote
Adjust tone and language to fit the product and the medium
Present drafts and ideas to clients, and discuss themes and copy changes
Consult sales and marketing staff on product details and the style and length of copy
Write sales letters, articles and other marketing and promotional material

mo.entry: Bachelor's degree. Figures cover animators and effects artists.
mo.what: Animates graphics, type and 3D for video, ads, games and apps.
mo.payNote: Range covers special effects artists and animators.
duties: Design complex graphics and animation using your own judgment and creativity
Create 2D and 3D images that show objects in motion or explain a process
Script, plan and create animated sequences under tight deadlines
Use story development, directing, cinematography and editing to build storyboards
Make objects and characters look lifelike with light, color, texture and shadow
Help design and produce multimedia campaigns, including budgets and schedules
Create designs and illustrations for product labels, packaging, mail and television
Develop presentations, web pages, promotional products and technical illustrations

il.where: Mostly freelance (58% of craft and fine artists)
il.entry: A strong portfolio matters more than the degree. Figures include fine artists.
il.what: Creates images for books, editorial, brands, games and products.
il.payNote: Range covers all craft and fine artists. Median is for fine artists, including illustrators.
duties: Create artwork with pens and ink, watercolor, charcoal, paint or software
Use line, space, color and perspective to create the effect you want
Meet with clients, editors, writers and art directors about the artwork
Keep a portfolio that shows your style, interests and abilities
Market your work through mailings, social media and your own website
Study new techniques and apply them to your work
Follow trends, research subjects and attend exhibitions
Photograph objects, places or scenes for reference

ux.where: Tech and media 27%, self-employed 13%, computer systems design 13%
ux.entry: Bachelor's degree, or a strong portfolio of shipped work.
ux.what: Designs websites and app screens people can use, and tests them with real users.
duties: Conduct user research to set design requirements and use feedback to improve designs
Develop new visual design concepts and revise them based on stakeholder feedback
Design, build and maintain websites using authoring, scripting and content tools
Write supporting code for websites and web applications
Work with front-end and back-end developers on web projects
Test websites on a schedule and after every revision
Find and fix problems uncovered by testing or customer feedback
Keep up with current web technologies and practices

fe.entry: Bachelor's degree is typical, though some employers hire from a strong portfolio of shipped work.
fe.what: Builds and maintains websites and web apps, turning designs into working code.
duties: Write the code behind websites and web apps
Build, run and maintain sites with scripting languages and content tools
Check code for standards and for how it works across browsers and devices
Choose the languages, design tools and applications for a project
Test sites on a schedule and after every change
Manage and update live websites
Turn user needs into technical requirements
Keep up with new tools through courses, reading and conferences

ve.where: Self-employed 35%, film and video 31%, publishing and media 11%
ve.entry: Bachelor's degree is typical. A reel of edited work matters most.
ve.what: Cuts raw footage into finished video for ads, social media, film and TV.
ve.payNote: Figures are for film and video editors.
duties: Arrange raw footage into a continuous story from a script or the director's notes
Choose the strongest shots from each scene
Add music, dialogue and sound effects, and fix errors
Trim segments to set lengths and reorder them for impact
Cut between camera angles so transitions flow
Run editing, titling and digital effects software
Review the assembled edit and decide what needs fixing
Work with sound, music, graphics and effects teams

cp.where: Self-employed 20%, film and video 19%, streaming and content 13%
cp.entry: Bachelor's degree, usually with a few years of production or coordinator experience.
cp.what: Plans and runs creative projects, from budget and schedule to crew, client and final delivery.
cp.payNote: Figures cover all producers and directors.
duties: Handle budgets, schedules, planning and marketing for productions
Meet with directors, managers, crew and writers on production details
Plan shot and scene details such as framing, camera movement and sound
Oversee camera, lighting, design and sound crews
Research topics using the internet, video archives and other sources
Review footage and recordings against production standards
Work with writers on script changes and final drafts
Direct shoots, recordings and live productions
